faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes GLA200 use?
faqLeft.a: It depends on the year. Early X156 models (2013–2017) use the M270 2.0-litre turbo petrol. Later X156 models (2017–2020) and some H247 cars use the M282 1.3-litre turbo petrol. Current H247 models from 2020 also use the M260 2.0-litre turbo petrol. Send us your registration and we'll confirm which one your car has.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes GLA200 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,200 across all engine codes. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my GLA200?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the M270, M282, or M260 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M270 GLA200 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, bearings and gaskets as standard on every M270 rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M282 GLA200 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We service the M282 to the same standard as our other GLA200 rebuilds.

faqRight.q: Do you rebuild M260 GLA200 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes. The M260 is the current engine in the GLA200 range, and we rebuild it with the same high standard of components.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used GLA200 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my GLA200 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a GLA200 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most GLA200 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
